defs.d: The physique of a human body; constitution or structure of a human body.
defs.ex: Rugby players are of sturdy build.

defs.d: Any of various versions of a software product as it is being developed for release to users.
defs.ex: The computer company has introduced a new prototype build to beta testers.

defs.d: To form (something) by combining materials or parts.
To develop or give form to (something) according to a plan or process.
A joke.
A comic strip.
Amusing; humorous; comical.
defs.ex: When I went to the circus, I only found the clowns funny.

defs.d: Strange or unusual, often implying unpleasant.
defs.ex: I've got a funny feeling that this isn't going to work.

defs.d: In an unusual manner; strangely.
A brief, unspecified amount of time.
defs.ex: Wait a moment, while I lock the front door.

defs.d: The smallest portion of time; an instant.
A person or group of people constituting a particular side in a contract or legal action.
defs.ex: The contract requires that the party of the first part pay the fee.

defs.d: A person.
To celebrate at a party, to have fun, to enjoy oneself.
defs.ex: We partied until the early hours.

defs.d: To take recreational drugs.
The act of appearing or coming into sight; the act of becoming visible to the eye.
defs.ex: His sudden appearance surprised me.

defs.d: A thing seen; a phenomenon; an apparition.
defs.ex: There was a strange appearance in the sky.

defs.d: A member of the Los Angeles gang The Bloods.

A vital liquid flowing in the bodies of many types of animals that usually conveys nutrients and oxygen. In vertebrates, it is colored red by hemoglobin, is conveyed by arteries and veins, is pumped by the heart and is usually generated in bone marrow.
defs.ex: The cultists gathered around a chalice of blood.

defs.d: A family relationship due to birth, such as that between siblings; contrasted with relationships due to marriage or adoption (see blood relative, blood relation, by blood).
To cause something to be covered with blood; to bloody.
To let blood (from); to bleed.
(followed by on or upon, formerly also by of) To be contingent or conditioned; to have something as a necessary condition; to hinge on.
defs.ex: We would like to go skiing, but it depends on the amount of snow.

defs.d: (followed by on or upon) To trust; to have confidence; to rely.
defs.ex: we depend on the mailman to come at the usual time.

defs.d: Furnishing help; giving aid; useful.
The undomesticated state of a wild animal
defs.ex: After mending the lion's leg, we returned him to the wild.

defs.d: (chiefly in the plural) a wilderness
To commit random acts of assault, robbery, and rape in an urban setting, especially as a gang.
Untamed; not domesticated; specifically, in an unbroken line of undomesticated animals (as opposed to feral, referring to undomesticated animals whose ancestors were domesticated).
defs.ex: Przewalski's horses are the only remaining wild horses.

defs.d: From or relating to wild creatures.
defs.ex: wild honey

defs.d: To pierce; now generally replaced by transfix.
To attach; to affix; to hold in place or at a particular time.
defs.ex: A dab of chewing gum will fix your note to the bulletin board.

defs.d: Not changing, not able to be changed, staying the same.
defs.ex: Every religion has its own fixed ideas.

defs.d: Stationary.
The act of connecting.
The point at which two or more things are connected.
defs.ex: My headache has no connection with me going out last night.

defs.d: To contend in physical conflict, either singly or in war, battle etc.
defs.ex: A wounded animal will fight like a maniac, relentless, savage and murderous.

defs.d: To contend in physical conflict with each other, either singly or in war, battle etc.
defs.ex: The two boxers have been fighting for more than half an hour.

defs.d: Engaged in war or other conflict.
Apt to provoke a fight.
A category into which sexually-reproducing organisms are divided on the basis of their reproductive roles in their species.
defs.ex: The effect of the medication is dependent upon age, sex, and other factors.

defs.d: Another category, especially of humans and especially based on sexuality or gender roles.
To determine the sex of an animal.
To have sex with.
To communicate with one's voice, to say words out loud.
defs.ex: I was so surprised I couldn't speak.

defs.d: To have a conversation.
defs.ex: It's been ages since we've spoken.

defs.d: Relating to speech
Speaking in a specified way
defs.ex: soft-spoken

defs.d: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.
The property surrounding one's house, typically dominated by one's lawn.
To confine to a yard.
Characterized by aggression; unjustly attacking; prone to behave in a way that involves attacking or arguing.
defs.ex: an aggressive policy, war, person, nation

defs.d: Of heuristics, source code optimization techniques, etc.: exploiting every opportunity to be applied.
To make clear, explain, interpret.
To make a declaration.
To disallow or reject.
defs.ex: I wanted to go to the party, but I was denied.

defs.d: To assert that something is not true.
defs.ex: Everyone knows he committed the crime, but he still denies it.

defs.d: In a widespread or large manner.
For the most part; mainly or chiefly.
defs.ex: They were largely successful in their efforts.

defs.d: To perform a work or labour; to exert power or strength, physical or mechanical; to act.
To produce an appropriate physical effect; to issue in the result designed by nature; especially to take appropriate effect on the human system.
(often in the plural) a rough section of a river or stream which is difficult to navigate due to the swift and turbulent motion of the water.
A burst of rapid fire.
Very swift or quick.
defs.ex: a rapid stream

defs.d: Steep, changing altitude quickly. (of a slope)
(archaic or colloquial) Rapidly.
An instance of having won a competition or battle or succeeded in an effort.
defs.ex: It was a great victory on the battlefield.

defs.d: The condition of having succeeded in a conflict or other effort.
To achieve a victory
